narrative:
The through-line today is **local-first software**. A Hacker News thread on running models on-device reached the front page — part of a broader shift away from always-connected architectures toward tools that work offline by default.

On the systems side, Rust's push into the kernel kept its momentum, while a Lobsters discussion made the case that static site generators still cover most of what teams reach for heavier build tooling to do.

The common thread: developers are trading cloud dependence and complex toolchains for simpler, self-contained setups.

articles.title: Why static site generators still matter
articles.summary: A community discussion on keeping build tooling simple.
